name: Sellou
description: A dense, nutty no-bake Moroccan sweet made from toasted flour, sesame seeds, almonds, and honey.
ingredients: a handful of fresh cilantro, chopped
instructions: Preheat your oven (or set up your steamer or frying station) and lightly grease your pan or molds with butter.
In a large bowl, whisk together the flatbread and ground cinnamon until evenly combined.
In a separate bowl, blend the toasted almonds with the chicken stock until smooth and well incorporated.
Gently fold the wet mixture into the dry ingredients, taking care not to overmix.
Transfer everything to your prepared pan or molds and cook — bake, steam, chill, or fry — until set, about 20 mins.
Remove from the heat and let it cool completely; this helps the texture firm up perfectly.
Garnish with cilantro or a dusting of dried apricots.
tips: Resist opening the oven door too early — a sudden change in temperature can cause the dessert to sink or crack.
For the cleanest slices, chill the finished dessert thoroughly before cutting.
Bring your toasted almonds to room temperature before mixing for a smoother, more even texture.
